name: Ramenya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood ramen shop: a holiday-change notice, a first day working part-time, a menu guide, a self-order machine trial, a delivery plans guide, a lesson in customer manners, teaching a junior how to cut noodles, the shop's history of changing its soup recipe, a service guide, a self-order-machine trend column, a hybrid discount-day system, a reflection on balancing efficiency and connection, and a one-year report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
